title: Landscape change proposal
description: The exact set of file effects a user is asked to approve, and the boundary every later step is bound by.

summary.description: What the change accomplishes, in the user's terms.

external_actions.description: Effects outside the working tree that need their own consent: commits, pushes, deployments, publication, messages, purchases, or production changes.

private_to_local.description: Paths holding personal information that must not be committed to a shared repository.

unverified.description: Facts or tool behaviors the proposal assumes but could not confirm.

path.description: Repository-relative path. For a move, the destination.

from.description: Required for a move: the current path.

concern.description: Which landscape layer owns this file. One file, one owning concern.

reason.description: Why this specific effect is needed. Not a restatement of the action.

destructive.description: True when the effect removes or overwrites work the user already had. Always true for a move or a delete; state it explicitly on every operation so consent is never inferred.
